summary.blockedSafety: none blocked by safety this run; KL-004 and KL-009 remain capped at retrospective/simulation by design

KL-000.nextGate: independent reimplementation. The confirmatory result was produced by an evaluator and a checker written in the same session; RESEARCH-METHOD.md requires that the implementation author not be the sole verifier. The exact falsifiable next step is: a second evaluator, written from the public schema by an author with no access to knowledge_ledger/transaction.py, must reproduce the same conclusion for all 176,120 exhaustive worlds. Any disagreement on any world rejects the shared assumption.
KL-000.claimAllowed: Within the declared bounds, the reference evaluator did not allow a recorded copy to change evidential mass, and did not allow an incomplete search to yield an absence conclusion. This is conformance behaviour in a frozen synthetic model.
knownLimits: ADV-001 high: an under-declared search space is undetectable, and the declaring party is the reporting party
ADV-002: one compromised issuer can mint unlimited roots
ADV-003: one appended conflicting record renders a whole transaction unevaluable
ADV-004: root identity is byte identity; no normalisation is specified
ADV-005: shared upstream dependency between roots is not representable
ADV-006: no issuer authentication; forged or replayed roots are indistinguishable
ADV-007: the claim proposition is free text and is never checked against the ledgers
KL-000.quantitativeCaveat: 75.7% of randomized worlds fail closed and produce no receipt, so eight of the ten invariants were exercised on 243,381 randomized worlds rather than 1,000,000. See results/kl000-effective-sample.json. The 95% rule-of-three upper bound for those eight is 1.23e-5 per receipt-producing world, not 3.0e-6.

KL-001.nextGate: Build a finite repository corpus with machine-checkable planted defects and clean controls, freeze generation before any evaluation, and preregister the false-clean endpoint. The first falsifiable check is narrower and can be run before any corpus exists: construct one repository whose mandatory file coverage is incomplete and show the pipeline cannot emit a clean conclusion for it. If it can, KL-001's first gate fails immediately.

KL-002.nextGate: Construct the source-laundering packets and preregister accuracy, Brier score, confident-error, abstention, root error, tokens, cost, and latency. The first falsifiable check needs no agent at all: 20 paraphrases of one false source must collapse to one root. KL-000 fixture C07 already demonstrates the evaluator does this for 20 identical rootIds; KL-002's real gate is whether an agent PIPELINE assigns the same rootId to 20 paraphrases, which is a root-ATTRIBUTION question the evaluator never sees.
